description: Replacement of all existing single-glazed timber sliding sash windows, casement windows and rear doors throughout with new double-glazed timber sliding sash, casement and rear doors to match the style, profile, character, and aesthetic of existing.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

[CLEV7_OSG_1TO2 Rev A, 26-4073-38PR-EL-003, 26-4073-38PR-EL-004, RICH7_SB_ISG_1TO2 Rev A, Single inward opening doors (24mm) Timeless window spec, 26-4073-38PR-WA-001]

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Sliding sash windows: Double glazed timber frames with colour, opening mechanism, style, detail and run through sash horns to match the existing windows to be replaced.

- Casement window: Double glazed timber frames with colour, opening mechanism, style and details to match the existing windows to be replaced.

- Doors: Double glazed timber doors 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC6 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - Where the existing windows to be replaced are obscure glazed and/or fixed shut they shall be replaced with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and where relevant shall be fixed shut to match the existing windows. The window(s) shall thereafter be permanently retained in this form.

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
